name: Government organization classification
description: What kind of body this is. It follows two existing standards: Popolo and the W3C Organization Ontology.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Government
hasDefinedTerm.description: The body at the top of a government, such as a city, county, state or national government. It has no parent. Its council, executive and departments sit under it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Legislature
hasDefinedTerm.description: An elected group that debates and decides, like a council, assembly, parliament or board of supervisors.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Executive
hasDefinedTerm.description: The office of the head of government, like a mayor's office, a cabinet or a city manager's office.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Department
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit that provides services under the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Agency
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body that has been given power by the executive, often working at arm's length from it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Committee
hasDefinedTerm.description: A small group inside a legislature or board, usually focused on one subject.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Commission
hasDefinedTerm.description: An appointed body that reviews, advises or rules on set matters.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Office
hasDefinedTerm.description: An office held by one person, like an auditor or ombudsman.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public enterprise
hasDefinedTerm.description: A business the government owns, like a utility, a transit operator or a port.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Division
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit inside a department or agency. It sits below the level that reports to the executive.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Bureau
hasDefinedTerm.description: A unit inside a department or agency. Governments use bureau, division and section in different ways. Use the word the government itself uses.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Authority
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body set up by law to run one job. It often has its own board and its own income, like a housing, transit or water authority.
